short_description: A standing shoulder exercise that lifts both arms to build shoulder endurance and upper-body mobility.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Let your arms hang at your sides.
Raise both arms straight out in front to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back to the start.
Repeat with a steady, controlled pace.
correct: Keep your shoulders relaxed, not shrugged.
Keep your core lightly engaged.
Move your arms at a controlled speed.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
mistakes: Don't swing your arms using momentum.
Don't shrug your shoulders on the way up.
Don't lean back as you raise your arms.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A fundamental lower-body exercise that strengthens the quads, glutes, and hamstrings.
how_to: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.

correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down throughout the movement.
Keep your chest up and back straight.
Breathe in on the way down, out on the way up.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast.
Don't round your lower back.
Don't let your heels lift off the floor.

short_description: A spinal mobility flow that alternates between arching and rounding the back to loosen the spine.
how_to: Start on all fours with your wrists under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Inhale, drop your belly, lift your chest and tailbone into Cow pose.
Exhale, round your spine toward the ceiling and tuck your chin into Cat pose.
Flow between the two positions with your breath.

correct: Breathe slowly and match each movement to your breath.
Keep your wrists stacked under your shoulders.
Move through your whole spine, not just one section.
Relax your neck rather than forcing it.
mistakes: Don't rush through the movement.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't strain your neck by forcing it too far.
Don't collapse your wrists inward.

short_description: A supine mobility drill that swings the legs side to side to open the hips and improve spinal rotation.
how_to: Lie on your back with your arms out to your sides for support.
Raise both legs so they are perpendicular to the floor.
Slowly lower your legs to one side, keeping them together.
Bring them back to the center and lower to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides with a controlled swing.
correct: Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
Move your legs at a slow, controlled pace.
Breathe steadily throughout.
Keep your core gently engaged.
mistakes: Don't let your opposite shoulder lift off the floor.
Don't force your legs all the way to the ground.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't swing your legs with momentum.

short_description: A combined core exercise that pairs a crunch with an alternating leg kick to work the abs and hip flexors.
how_to: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor into a crunch.
Extend one leg out straight while keeping the other bent.

correct: Keep your lower back controlled against the floor.
Keep your chin away from your chest.
Keep your shoulders lifted throughout each rep.
Move your legs in a smooth, deliberate motion.
mistakes: Don't arch your lower back.
Don't pull on your neck.
Don't rush the kicks.
Don't let your shoulders drop between reps.

short_description: A prone back-extension stretch that opens the chest and lengthens the abdominal muscles.
how_to: Lie face down with your hands flat under your shoulders.

Straighten your arms as much as feels comfortable.

Don't pull on your neck.

short_description: A supine leg-lift variation that targets the lower abs by pressing the heels straight up toward the ceiling.

short_description: An alternating V-up that challenges the core by reaching one hand toward the opposite raised foot.

short_description: A supine core exercise that lifts straight legs to strengthen the lower abs and hip flexors.

Lower your legs back down in a controlled manner.

Keep your legs as straight as possible.
